description: SYNTHORA marine-wave-forecast: sea state for any coast/port or chokepoint (Hormuz, Suez, Panama, Malacca, Gibraltar, Bab el-Mandeb, Dover presets) — wave height, period, swell, Douglas-scale verdict and navigability flag. Complements chokepoint-transits for shipping disruption markets. Source: open-meteo Marine (ECMWF/NOAA WaveWatch III, no key). $0.005 USDC x402 Base. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]
